main_text.p: cem ulcisci. Et tamen ex officio tenetur patri nocenti, & perduelli, occurrere.

5. Objicitur. Pater genuit,Petrus de Anchor. conf. 75. num.5. vitam communicavit, adeoque fides, natura, dilectio, jubent, patri esse parcendum. Resp.l.ioi.D. de leg.3. Verum quidem parens genuit, sed etiam patria genuisse dicitur, quae ideo dulcissima appellata. Ut in concursu, major hujus, quam illius habenda sit ratio. Quid si enim Tyrannidem occupare,Cicero 3. de Offic. si patriam perdere, conabitur pater, sistebit[?] & filius? Immo obsecrabit patrem, ne id faciat: si nihil proficiet, accusabit, minabitur, & ad postremum, si ad perniciem patriae res spectabit, patriae salutem anteponet saluti patris.

page.notes: The catchword "gis" is the start of the next page's word "magis", printed at the bottom right. "sistebit" is uncertain: the long s makes it hard to read. "l.38. 9." in the margin is hard to make out, so the § sign is doubtful. "l.ioi.D." is printed this way and is copied as printed. Italic type runs from "Quid" to the end of the paragraph. Note positions are approximate where a note spans several lines.
